value.answer: Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash has been introduced with a 50% introductory price cut, targeting coding and automated business workflows. The model's introductory API price is $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens, running through the end of 2026. This new model emphasizes more diligent planning and execution, aiming to reduce manual intervention in engineering and business workflows.
